Class GeminiServiceTest

@IsTest()
private class GeminiServiceTest

Test class for GeminiService. Validates prompt execution against mocked Gemini API responses covering successful calls, malformed JSON responses, and HTTP error codes.

Group:
    Test Classes

Since:
    05/17/2025

Version:
    1.0


Change Log

Members

  Modifiers and Type Name Description
private static void
runErrorPromptTest()
Verifies that runPrompt returns a failed Response with an error message when the Gemini API returns a successful HTTP status but the response body contains invalid JSON that cannot be parsed.
private static void
runPromptTest()
Verifies that runPrompt returns a successful Response with generated text when the Gemini API returns a valid JSON response containing candidates.
private static void
runServiceErrorTest()
Verifies that runPrompt returns a failed Response containing the error body when the Gemini API returns an HTTP 404 error status code.
private static void
setupData()
Creates BlazeBiteSettings__c custom settings required by GeminiService to retrieve the API key.
